svg.title: Harbor Goods AWS cost optimization audit: exports to ranked savings
svg.desc: Read-only exports (Cost and Usage Report, Compute Optimizer, Trusted Advisor, inventories) and data/assumptions.json feed the offline costaudit scripts, which price 16 savings findings, rank them into quick wins and planned work with commitments sized last, and render the report; make verify reproduces every figure from the data.
